card: Replaces the FreeBSD cross-compilation CI job with a native build and test job inside a FreeBSD virtual machine using vmactions/freebsd-vm. Bitcoin Core currently only cross-compiles BSD binaries in PR CI without running tests, allowing platform regressions to reach master until nightly runs detect them. The branch currently includes a temporary trial commit running 25 repeated matrix jobs and disabling other CI tasks to test caching, which must be dropped before merge.
changed_since_previous: Added a temporary trial commit disabling all other CI jobs to run 25 FreeBSD VM trials to evaluate cache retrieval, and extracted CI workflow templates.
evidence: "We currently cross-compile BSD binaries without testing them in this repository. Running tests before merge should help catch platform-specific regressions that would otherwise first appear in nightly builds. This starts with FreeBSD because it has been the most reliable BSD platform in the nightly jobs." (PR description)

"FreeBSD lsof can emit the following warning during parallel tests: lsof: WARNING -- reading lockf list failed: Cannot allocate memory... The functional test runner treats nonempty stderr as failure even when a test exits successfully." (commit 7cd993e93f)
problem: Pull request CI currently only cross-compiles FreeBSD binaries without running unit or functional tests. Platform-specific bugs and test breakages on FreeBSD go undetected until nightly builds run.

risk.why: CI workflow and test framework changes cannot affect release binaries or node operation.

scope_notes: The branch currently includes a temporary commit ('NOMERGE: run 25 BSD trials and skip other jobs') that disables all other CI jobs and runs a 25-trial matrix to evaluate VM cache retrieval.
summary: Replaces the FreeBSD cross-compilation CI job with a native build and full test suite execution inside a FreeBSD virtual machine using vmactions/freebsd-vm. Keeps NetBSD and OpenBSD as cross-compilation targets, updates CI scripts to support native FreeBSD toolchains, and silences lsof warnings in the functional test runner on FreeBSD.
